entry.title: Kullen Lighthouse
entry.note: Mapped house long axis resolves native+X east/slightly south; native+Z runs into the attached house south of the tower. The seaward watchroom faces native-Z, and mapped small roof identifies the northeast columned porch. Origin is the tower center at local site grade, not focal elevation. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
